# Code of Conduct

This project is a small, focused community for sharing thinking tools. We keep the rules short.

## Our Standards

- Be respectful. Disagree with ideas, not people.
- Assume good faith. Most misunderstandings are not malice.
- No harassment, personal attacks, discrimination, or sustained disruption.
- Keep discussion on-topic and constructive. Critique models, not contributors.
- English is fine but not required; be patient with non-native speakers.

## Scope

Applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other project space.

## Reporting

Report concerns by opening a GitHub issue (or marking it confidential if the platform supports it). Maintainers will review and respond.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, remove, or reject contributions and, for repeated or severe violations, block offending accounts.

For a fuller framework, see the Contributor Covenant v2.1: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
